name: Sarn Vowkeeper

Traits.name: Aura of Authority
Traits.text: While in a 10-foot Emanation originating from Sarn, Sarn and its allies have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided Sarn doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: Sarn makes three Mace attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Shield Bash.

Actions.name: Mace
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 17 (3d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of Sarn's next turn.
Actions.clause: a templar priest with a mace

Actions.name: Shield Bash
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw*: DC 15, one creature within 5 feet that Sarn can see. *Failure:*  9 (2d4 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

lore: Defrocked for a heresy he will not name, Sarn keeps his vows anyway, standing guard over pilgrims and roadside shrines with the mace and shield he trusts more than any prayer.
